einzeiler: The dark history of Frank Lloyd Wright and the 1914 massacre at his Taliesin estate
kurzfassung: Frank Lloyd Wright designed his masterpiece estate Taliesin in Wisconsin while carrying out a notorious extramarital affair that shocked high society. In August 1914, a disgruntled handyman named Julian Carlton went on a brutal rampage, murdering seven people with an axe and setting the house on fire. Despite the tragedy and a subsequent decades-long career slump, Wright went on to create some of his most iconic architectural works later in life.
stichpunkte: Taliesin is widely considered Frank Lloyd Wright's architectural masterpiece and an autobiography written in wood and stone.
Wright built the sprawling Wisconsin estate in the midst of a major public scandal surrounding his affair with Mamah Borthwick.
The couple abandoned their families in 1909 to travel through Europe, making them social pariahs upon their return.
On August 15, 1914, estate handyman Julian Carlton attacked Borthwick and her visiting children with an axe before setting the dining room on fire.
Carlton killed seven of the nine people present during the lunch massacre, later attempting suicide by drinking hydrochloric acid.
Carlton survived the acid and fire, ultimately starving to death in jail seven weeks later.
The tragedy deeply affected Wright, leading to a twenty-year professional dry spell and a series of tumultuous relationships.
Wright eventually rebounded to design renowned works like Taliesin West and the Guggenheim Museum during his later years.

clips.text: The architect deliberately omitted drainage channels so that frozen precipitation would build up into decorative spikes along the roofline.

clips.hook: An unpaid grocery bill left behind
clips.text: Before abandoning his family, the famous designer left behind a massive unpaid food tab on the kitchen counter.

clips.hook: The brutal attack at the estate
clips.text: The perpetrator executed a violent assault against the architect's partner and guests before using fuel to trap everyone inside a burning room.

clips.hook: A failed suicide attempt in the basement
clips.text: After hiding in the building's utility area, the killer tried to end his life by swallowing harsh chemicals, but the method failed.

clips.hook: Surprising topics in the new book
clips.text: The hosts highlight several unusual subjects covered in their publication, ranging from retro bedding to breakfast pastries.
